$225 monthly build credit included then billed per build, high-priority queue, 2 concurrent builds, 1 TiB update storage, 50,000 monthly active users for updates

cautions.en: The Production plan's $199/month is a credit, not a flat fee: extra builds beyond the credit are billed per build ($1-4 each) and extra concurrency is $50/slot.

capabilities.en: Cloud build and code signing for React Native / Expo apps for both Android and iOS, including apps with custom native code.
Over-the-air (OTA) update delivery (EAS Update) without going through app store review.
Automated submission to the Google Play Store and Apple App Store (EAS Submit).
CI/CD workflow automation and app performance monitoring (EAS Workflows, EAS Insights).

limitations.en: Free tier is capped at 15 Android and 15 iOS builds per month and runs on a low-priority build queue, so builds can be slow at peak times.
The Production plan's headline price is a usage credit, not a fixed monthly fee: teams with heavy build or concurrency needs pay significantly more.

reason.en: Direct competitor for cloud CI/CD builds of React Native and mobile apps.
Alternative cloud deployment target for the web/API side of Expo projects.
Alternative hosting for the web output of an Expo project.
